objective: finish implementing everything from the implementation raodmap
scope: F08 font-file admission, selected whole-face native preparation and private visible preview. Document font binding/embedding/persistence remain required and unfinished.
method: Read actual immutable local source bytes; disposable self-contained parser workers; strict host page/face/signature/digest validation; native loaded FontFaces deliberately unregistered.
Compare extracted selected TTC tables against independent FontTools source readers, correcting only head.checkSumAdjustment; independently validate SFNT checksums.
Compare both private shaping and visible copied canvas PNG buffers against the original standalone TTF face using independent Pillow. This is not physical display or broad typography quality proof.
Run the normal production release without development globals; retain every final release/source identity before and after acceptance.
Retain the default-concurrency timeout failures, native development reload failure and missing-reader-environment failures rather than calling those initial runs green.

verification.productionReconciliation: The full run passed122 and failed6 only at missing independent reader dependencies; all six complete workflows then passed with dedicated environments on identical authored inputs/release. No product/test changes between those runs.
verification.freezeScope: Initial full production/reader-correction inputs stayed frozen; final notice-only inputs also stayed frozen. The exact two authored inputs and one non-runtime text resource changed by LF normalization are retained separately; all101 other release resources are identical.

decisions: Original geometric font fixtures, including differing advances/outlines, compressed fonts, TTC/DSIG and datafork; genuine Manrope variable-axis metadata/native preparation.

Reject the initial iframe-only visible preview: native buffer checks passed but Chromium displayed fallback content with scripts disabled. Keep the private font set and blit pixels into a visible parent canvas; test visible equality, theme and width changes.
Keep the source inspector/client lazy and independently compile the parser worker. These isolate parser dependencies; repeated unbundled plugin reload still fails and is not represented as fixed.

Add direct request-error diagnostics without weakening plugin assertions; place screenshots in the test output directory. Normal-production plugin lifecycle now explicitly covers persistence, update, export, removal and repeated reloads without globals.
limits: One unbundled development plugin third-reload test remains failing with ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES. Native matrices are not all green. Direct/control observations and parser optimizer experiments do not establish which Chromium quota is responsible.
No document font installation/binding, original/derived source store, font embedding, project/workspace/history persistence, removal/relinking or cross-document font transfer is delivered.
Metadata/native container coverage and eight exact small-font buffers do not establish broad real-font shaping, glyph/language/variable-axis/device quality.

Native FontFace.load, Blob reads and crypto operations cannot be forcibly cancelled after starting; late results are discarded. No immediate native-memory reclamation or whole-process peak-memory guarantee.
The modal fits390px; the existing editor shell still has a760px minimum. No mobile-editor claim.

No sustained editor-wide latency/60fps, physical-display/hardware-GPU or full roadmap acceptance follows from these checks. Remaining F08/F14 and every unfinished original portfolio/T23/T24 gate remain active.

import sys,json,hashlib,struct,io
from pathlib import Path
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont,TTCollection
from fontTools.ttLib.sfnt import calcChecksum
from PIL import Image,ImageChops
root=Path('/home/kestrel/projects/luma-editor');roots=[Path(value) for value in sys.argv[1:]];fixtures=root/'tests/fixtures/fonts';manifest=json.loads((fixtures/'manifest.json').read_text());out={'fixtureSources':[],'extractedFaces':[],'nativePixels':[]}
for name,expected in manifest.items():
 body=(fixtures/name).read_bytes();assert len(body)==expected['bytes'];assert hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()==expected['sha256'];out['fixtureSources'].append({'name':name,**expected})
collection=TTCollection(fixtures/'Collection.ttc')
for path in (p for root in roots for p in root.rglob('extracted-bold.ttf')):
 body=path.read_bytes();native=TTFont(io.BytesIO(body));original=collection.fonts[1]
 assert set(native.reader.keys())==set(original.reader.keys());tags=[]
 for tag in native.reader.keys():
  a=bytearray(native.reader[tag]);b=bytearray(original.reader[tag])
  if tag=='head':a[8:12]=b[8:12]=bytes(4)
  assert a==b,(tag,'selected whole table differs');assert calcChecksum(bytes(a))==native.reader.tables[tag].checkSum,(tag,'table checksum differs');tags.append(tag)
 padded=body+bytes((-len(body))%4);total=sum(struct.unpack('>'+str(len(padded)//4)+'I',padded))&0xffffffff;assert total==0xb1b0afba
 out['extractedFaces'].append({'path':str(path),'bytes':len(body),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),'tableTags':sorted(tags),'wholeTablesEqual':True,'sfntChecksum':hex(total)})
assert out['extractedFaces'],'No real browser-extracted face evidence'
for path in (p for root in roots for p in root.rglob('font-source-*-reference.png')):
 reference=Image.open(path).convert('RGBA');stem=path.name.replace('-reference.png','')
 for kind in ['actual','visible']:
  candidate=path.with_name(stem+'-'+kind+'.png');actual=Image.open(candidate).convert('RGBA');assert actual.size==reference.size
  assert all(hi==0 for lo,hi in ImageChops.difference(actual,reference).getextrema()),(candidate,'native pixels differ')
  out['nativePixels'].append({'path':str(candidate),'width':actual.width,'height':actual.height,'channels':actual.width*actual.height*4,'maximumDifference':0})
assert len(out['nativePixels'])>=4
out['independentTools']={'fontTools':__import__('fontTools').version,'Pillow':Image.__version__}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
